FINAL DEEP QA — VERIFY ALL 12 IVX SENIOR DEVELOPER AGENTS

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Perform a real deep QA of all 12 IVX Senior Developer agents.

Do not assume they are complete because a prior certification said PASS.

Re-test every agent independently and end to end.

The purpose is to identify:

- what is truly working
- what is partially working
- what is simulated
- what is only narrative
- what is using mock data
- what fails after restart
- what cannot write code
- what cannot run tests
- what cannot deploy
- what cannot recover
- what cannot produce verifiable evidence

Do not return a general summary only.

Test each of the 12 agents one by one.

==================================================
1. IDENTIFY THE 12 AGENTS
==================================================

Return the real production registry of all 12 agents:

For each agent provide:

- Agent number
- Agent ID
- Agent name
- Assigned role
- Worker/service ID
- Model/provider
- Current status
- Last heartbeat
- Last completed job
- Last failed job
- Current queue depth
- Enabled capabilities
- Disabled capabilities
- Credential dependencies
- Database record ID
- Code/config source file

Do not invent agent names.

If fewer than 12 real agent records exist, mark:

AGENT REGISTRY = FAIL

==================================================
2. VERIFY AGENT SEPARATION
==================================================

Confirm whether the 12 agents are truly separate workers or only labels using the same execution process.

For each agent verify:

- unique agent ID
- unique role
- separate job ownership
- isolated task state
- isolated memory/context
- isolated logs
- separate heartbeat
- separate concurrency control
- separate failure state
- separate performance metrics

Classify each agent as:

- REAL INDEPENDENT AGENT
- SHARED WORKER WITH ROLE
- UI-ONLY LABEL
- MOCK AGENT
- UNKNOWN

Do not call 12 labels “12 agents” if only one worker exists.

==================================================
3. REQUIRED CAPABILITY TEST MATRIX
==================================================

Test every agent against the capabilities appropriate to its role.

Core capability tests:

1. Read repository
2. Search codebase
3. Identify root cause
4. Modify an approved file
5. Create a new file
6. Delete a safe temporary file
7. Run lint
8. Run typecheck
9. Run unit tests
10. Run integration tests
11. Run security scan
12. Run dependency scan
13. Commit changes
14. Push to GitHub
15. Trigger CI
16. Read CI result
17. Trigger Render deployment
18. Verify /health
19. Verify /version
20. Write proof ledger
21. Reject replay
22. Roll back safely
23. Recover after failure
24. Continue after restart
25. Report exact evidence

For capabilities outside an agent’s assigned role, mark:

NOT REQUIRED

Do not mark PASS without execution evidence.

==================================================
4. TEST AGENT 1 — LEAD ARCHITECT
==================================================

Test whether the Lead Architect can:

- map the full IVX architecture
- identify frontend/backend/worker boundaries
- map database dependencies
- map authentication boundaries
- identify duplicate modules
- identify dead code
- identify unsafe coupling
- propose a migration plan
- produce file-level actions
- avoid vague narrative
- correctly distinguish current production from legacy code

Give it one real architecture problem.

Required evidence:

- files inspected
- dependency graph
- root cause
- exact recommendation
- contradictions found
- PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

==================================================
5. TEST AGENT 2 — BACKEND SENIOR DEVELOPER
==================================================

Give a real backend defect.

Test:

- route discovery
- request validation
- authentication
- authorization
- database access
- error handling
- retries
- idempotency
- logging
- tests
- production-safe fix

Required evidence:

- route
- file/function
- failing test
- code change
- passing test
- API result
- request ID
- commit SHA

==================================================
6. TEST AGENT 3 — MOBILE SENIOR DEVELOPER
==================================================

Test Android/iOS/Expo capabilities:

- app startup
- navigation
- owner login
- keyboard behavior
- session persistence
- API connectivity
- image upload
- video upload
- reels playback
- crash handling
- release configuration
- Android application ID
- iOS bundle ID
- build validation

Required result:

- Android test
- iOS test where available
- Expo test
- crash log
- screenshots
- build evidence
- PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

==================================================
7. TEST AGENT 4 — WEB/LANDING DEVELOPER
==================================================

Test:

- landing page
- registration
- responsiveness
- robots.txt
- sitemap.xml
- SEO metadata
- app/landing design parity
- API integration
- form submission
- error handling
- no page jumping
- no white banner
- no broken images
- no fake data

Run at multiple screen widths.

Required evidence:

- tested URLs
- viewport sizes
- failures
- files changed
- screenshots
- production result

==================================================
8. TEST AGENT 5 — DATABASE/SUPABASE ENGINEER
==================================================

Test:

- schema inspection
- migrations
- RLS policies
- Auth/member sync
- duplicate prevention
- orphan record detection
- storage policies
- realtime
- transaction integrity
- backup/restore readiness
- proof ledger integrity
- indexes and query performance

Required evidence:

- tables inspected
- RLS results
- duplicate counts
- orphan counts
- migration status
- performance findings
- safe repair evidence

==================================================
9. TEST AGENT 6 — SECURITY ENGINEER
==================================================

Test:

- secret scan
- credential exposure
- auth bypass
- privilege escalation
- service-role exposure
- owner-route protection
- replay attacks
- duplicate deployment attempts
- rate limiting
- malicious uploads
- dependency vulnerabilities
- log redaction
- token expiry handling

Required evidence:

- test ID
- attack attempted
- expected response
- actual response
- HTTP status
- vulnerability severity
- remediation
- regression test

==================================================
10. TEST AGENT 7 — QA AUTOMATION ENGINEER
==================================================

Test whether it can create and execute:

- unit tests
- integration tests
- browser E2E tests
- API tests
- mobile E2E tests
- regression tests
- load tests
- failure injection
- timeout tests
- restart tests
- duplicate submission tests

Give it one known defect and verify it first reproduces the failure, then proves the fix.

Required evidence:

- failing test before fix
- passing test after fix
- CI run ID
- coverage impact
- flaky-test count

==================================================
11. TEST AGENT 8 — DEVOPS/CI ENGINEER
==================================================

Test:

- GitHub authentication
- correct repository target
- branch protection
- workflow execution
- CI gates
- artifact generation
- Render deployment
- SHA parity
- environment binding
- restart behavior
- rollback
- duplicate deployment prevention
- deployment logs

Required evidence:

- GitHub HEAD
- CI run ID
- Render deployment ID
- API SHA
- Worker SHA
- /version SHA
- rollback target
- PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

==================================================
12. TEST AGENT 9 — AUTONOMOUS WORKER ENGINEER
==================================================

Test the complete worker execution lifecycle:

- job accepted
- owner approval verified
- authorization consumed
- task queued
- command executed
- timeout handled
- subprocess tree killed
- cancellation handled
- queue released
- next job executes
- proof ledger written
- restart recovery
- no duplicate execution

Run:

- successful job
- failing job
- timed-out job
- cancelled job
- restarted job

Required evidence:

- job IDs
- state transitions
- timestamps
- worker ID
- final status
- orphan-process count
- proof ledger IDs

==================================================
13. TEST AGENT 10 — AI/CHAT ENGINEER
==================================================

Test IVX IA Chat:

- answer quality
- persistent history
- stable message IDs
- no duplicate messages
- correct ordering
- scroll behavior
- keyboard behavior
- attachment handling
- image analysis
- PDF analysis
- video handling
- tool execution
- code-task creation
- truthful status reporting
- no fabricated evidence
- no fake narrative

Give it:

- one coding question
- one production diagnosis
- one document task
- one ambiguous request

Required evidence:

- responses
- tool calls
- trace IDs
- errors
- persistence after restart

==================================================
14. TEST AGENT 11 — DATA/ANALYTICS ENGINEER
==================================================

Test:

- real member counts
- investor counts
- buyer counts
- property counts
- deal counts
- reels counts
- transaction counts
- dashboard parity
- platform parity
- duplicate detection
- source attribution
- fake-data detection
- stale-data detection
- report generation

Required result:

- database count
- API count
- Android count
- iOS count
- web count
- dashboard count
- mismatch explanation
- repair evidence

==================================================
15. TEST AGENT 12 — RELEASE/RECOVERY ENGINEER
==================================================

Test:

- release creation
- release notes
- versioning
- APK artifact
- checksum
- deployment verification
- rollback trigger
- rollback completion
- recovery after failed deploy
- database compatibility
- worker restart
- stale-job recovery
- proof after rollback

Required evidence:

- release ID
- version
- build ID
- artifact path
- checksum
- deployment ID
- rollback SHA
- recovery timestamps

==================================================
16. TEST REAL COLLABORATION BETWEEN AGENTS
==================================================

Run one real multi-agent task.

Example:

Member registration fails from landing page.

Required collaboration:

- Architect maps issue
- Web agent reproduces UI defect
- Backend agent audits route
- Database agent audits insert/RLS
- Security agent checks abuse risk
- QA agent creates regression test
- DevOps agent deploys fix
- Release agent verifies rollback
- Lead agent produces final evidence

Verify:

- task handoffs
- no duplicate work
- no conflicting edits
- one task owner at a time
- shared evidence
- final merged result
- no circular planning
- no endless agent-to-agent messages

==================================================
17. TEST CONCURRENCY
==================================================

Run concurrent jobs:

- 2 agents
- 4 agents
- 8 agents
- 12 agents

Verify:

- queue integrity
- file-locking
- branch isolation
- merge conflict handling
- database lock behavior
- resource limits
- rate limits
- no duplicated deployment
- no overwritten changes
- no corrupted proof ledger

Return:

- jobs submitted
- jobs completed
- jobs failed
- conflicts
- retries
- average duration
- maximum duration

==================================================
18. TEST FAILURE AND RECOVERY
==================================================

Force these failures:

- expired GitHub token
- Render API timeout
- Supabase unavailable
- AI provider unavailable
- lint hangs
- test fails
- build fails
- deployment fails
- worker restarts
- network disconnects
- duplicate approval
- duplicate job
- stale job
- corrupted response
- missing optional credential

Verify each agent:

- detects the failure
- reports exact error
- does not fabricate PASS
- does not expose secrets
- retries only when safe
- stops when required
- recovers correctly
- records evidence

==================================================
19. TEST TRUTHFULNESS AND EVIDENCE QUALITY
==================================================

For every agent verify:

- no invented SHA
- no invented deployment ID
- no invented job ID
- no invented test count
- no fake screenshots
- no unsupported PASS
- no claim of production execution from local-only test
- no claim of independent agent if shared worker
- no claim of completed deployment without owner approval
- no hidden blocker

Any fabricated evidence is:

P0 FAILURE

==================================================
20. TEST PERFORMANCE
==================================================

For every agent record:

- first-response time
- task-start time
- execution duration
- timeout count
- retry count
- token/model usage
- CPU/memory where available
- queue delay
- completion rate

Required thresholds must be defined for:

- simple diagnosis
- code fix
- test suite
- deployment
- multi-agent task

==================================================
21. TEST COST AND RESOURCE CONTROLS
==================================================

Verify:

- per-agent budget
- per-job budget
- runaway-task protection
- model-selection rules
- maximum retries
- maximum duration
- cancellation
- duplicate-job prevention
- expensive-tool approval
- owner spending visibility

No agent may execute unlimited work without limits.

==================================================
22. TEST OWNER CONTROLS
==================================================

Verify owner can:

- enable agent
- disable agent
- pause job
- resume job
- cancel job
- reassign task
- approve code change
- approve deployment
- reject deployment
- view logs
- view evidence
- view cost
- view failure reason
- trigger rollback

Non-owner must be denied.

==================================================
23. TEST PERSISTENCE
==================================================

Restart:

- API
- worker
- database connection
- frontend
- one agent job

Verify:

- agent registry persists
- roles persist
- queues persist
- jobs persist
- message history persists
- proof ledger persists
- completed jobs do not rerun
- consumed approvals remain consumed
- failed jobs remain recoverable

==================================================
24. CODE AND CONFIG AUDIT
==================================================

Map all files that implement the 12-agent system.

Return:

- registry files
- role definitions
- agent prompts
- worker files
- queue files
- scheduler files
- authorization files
- proof ledger files
- dashboard files
- model/provider files
- limits/config files
- tests

Identify:

- duplicates
- dead agents
- placeholder agents
- shared IDs
- hardcoded PASS states
- mock responses
- demo-only routes
- incomplete TODOs
- hidden feature flags

==================================================
25. DATABASE AUDIT
==================================================

Audit tables for:

- agents
- agent_roles
- agent_capabilities
- agent_jobs
- agent_job_steps
- agent_logs
- agent_heartbeats
- agent_costs
- agent_evidence
- approvals
- proof_ledger
- deployment_jobs

Verify:

- unique constraints
- foreign keys
- RLS
- indexes
- terminal states
- retry counters
- idempotency
- ownership
- timestamps

==================================================
26. DASHBOARD QA
==================================================

The owner dashboard must show all 12 agents.

For each agent display:

- status
- current task
- progress
- last heartbeat
- last result
- current queue
- failures
- evidence
- cost
- model
- capability state
- pause/cancel controls

No static fake cards.

Every value must come from live records.

==================================================
27. FIX EVERY FAILURE
==================================================

For every confirmed issue:

- Severity
- Agent affected
- Root cause
- File/function
- Fix
- Test
- Commit
- CI
- Deployment
- Production verification

Severity:

- P0: fabricated evidence, security bypass, destructive action, data loss
- P1: agent cannot complete core task
- P2: unreliable recovery, partial capability
- P3: UI/reporting issue

Do not stop after finding issues.

==================================================
28. FINAL CERTIFICATION TABLE
==================================================

Return this table for all 12 agents:

Agent:
Role:
Independent agent:
Live heartbeat:
Real job completed:
Code read:
Code write:
Tests:
Commit:
GitHub push:
CI:
Deploy:
Recovery:
Proof ledger:
Owner control:
Security:
Truthfulness:
Final status:
Outstanding blockers:

Allowed final status:

- VERIFIED SENIOR DEVELOPER
- PARTIAL
- FAIL
- NOT A REAL INDEPENDENT AGENT

==================================================
29. FINAL SYSTEM VERDICT
==================================================

Return:

12 REAL AGENTS PRESENT:
YES / NO

12 AGENTS INDEPENDENT:
YES / PARTIAL / NO

ALL 12 CAN COMPLETE THEIR ASSIGNED ROLE:
YES / PARTIAL / NO

ALL 12 PRODUCE VERIFIABLE EVIDENCE:
YES / PARTIAL / NO

ALL 12 RECOVER AFTER FAILURE:
YES / PARTIAL / NO

ALL 12 ARE OWNER-CONTROLLED:
YES / PARTIAL / NO

MULTI-AGENT COLLABORATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

CONCURRENCY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS CODE CHANGE:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS QA:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

FINAL CERTIFICATION:

- 12/12 VERIFIED
- X/12 VERIFIED
- NOT VERIFIED

Do not reuse the previous certification result.

Re-run the entire audit using current production evidence and report exactly what is wrong now.
